A Dance of Fire and Ice.description: Guide two orbiting planets along winding paths by keeping time with the music.

Adorable Home.description: Decorate a cozy home, care for cats, and share everyday moments with your partner.

Among Us.description: Complete tasks with your crewmates while trying to discover the impostors hiding among you.

Arknights: Endfield.description: Explore Talos-II, lead a team into battle, and build production systems to support your expeditions.

Call of Duty.description: Take part in fast-paced firefights with a range of weapons and competitive multiplayer modes.

Celeste.description: Help Madeline climb Celeste Mountain through challenging platforming stages and a story about facing your own doubts.

Daddy Long Legs.description: Try to walk as far as possible on impossibly long legs, timing each step to avoid falling over.

Dark Deception.description: Collect shards in nightmarish mazes while avoiding the creatures that hunt you.

Dumb Ways to Die.description: Keep a cast of accident-prone characters safe through a collection of quick, increasingly tricky mini-games.

Dumb Ways to Die 2: The Games.description: Take on a new collection of absurd sporting challenges and try to keep the characters out of danger.

Farlight 84.description: Team up in a hero-based battle royale and combine shooting with character abilities to survive each match.

Good Pizza, Great Pizza.description: Run a pizza shop, interpret customers’ orders, and prepare pizzas while managing your ingredients and earnings.

Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town.description: Restore a farm, raise animals, grow crops, and build friendships with the residents of Mineral Town.

Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral To.description: Start a new life as a farmer in Mineral Town, balancing crops, animals, friendships, and romance.

Honkai: Star Rail.description: Travel aboard the Astral Express, explore different worlds, and assemble a team for turn-based battles.

In Sink.description: Work with a partner to solve escape-room puzzles using communication, observation, and teamwork.

It Takes Two.description: Play as Cody and May, a couple transformed into dolls, and work together through imaginative challenges.

Minecraft.description: Explore a world of blocks, gather resources, build whatever you imagine, and choose your own adventures.

Neighbours from Hell.description: Sneak through your neighbour’s home and arrange elaborate pranks without getting caught.

Peak.description: Climb a dangerous mountain alone or with friends, managing your stamina and helping one another reach the summit.

Penguin Diner.description: Help Penny seat customers, serve meals, and keep a busy penguin restaurant running smoothly.

Penguin Diner 2.description: Join Penny for another restaurant adventure, serving penguins and upgrading the diner as business grows.

Plants vs. Zombies.description: Build a defense of plants with different abilities to protect your home from waves of zombies.

Rhythm Hive.description: Tap along to songs by HYBE artists and collect artist cards as you play.

Roblox.description: Explore a wide variety of experiences created by the community, from obstacle courses to role-playing worlds.

Smash Hit.description: Throw metal balls to shatter glass obstacles as you move through surreal, music-driven environments.

Soul Knight.description: Explore randomized dungeons, discover weapons, and dodge enemy attacks as you fight through each run.

Split Fiction.description: Follow two writers trapped in their own stories, working together through worlds inspired by science fiction and fantasy.

Stardew Valley.description: Turn an inherited farm into a new home, grow crops, explore the mines, and get to know the people of Pelican Town.

Subway Surfers.description: Dash along railway tracks, dodge trains and obstacles, and collect coins while escaping the inspector.

Super Mecha Champions.description: Fight as a pilot and summon a powerful mecha to battle other players in an anime-inspired city.

Temple Run.description: Escape with a stolen idol, jumping, sliding, and turning to avoid hazards along an endless route.

Temple Run 2.description: Continue the chase through winding paths, cliffs, and mine tracks while collecting coins and avoiding obstacles.

Toilet Time.description: Play a collection of silly bathroom-themed mini-games that test your timing and reactions.

Tomb of the Mask.description: Dash through trap-filled mazes with a mysterious mask that lets you climb walls.

Tower of Fantasy.description: Explore a science-fiction world, discover new weapons, and take on enemies with other players.

Tsuki’s Odyssey.description: Spend time in Mushroom Village with Tsuki, decorating his home, fishing, and meeting the local residents.

Virtual Villagers: A New Home.description: Help a small group of villagers establish a home on an island, learn skills, and uncover its mysteries.

Virtual Villagers Origins 2.description: Build a village on Isola, gather and craft resources, and solve puzzles while caring for your growing community.

Wuthering Waves.description: Explore a world recovering from catastrophe as Rover, meeting Resonators and facing enemies in fast-paced combat.
